mission_priority: XRP intelligence and prediction-engine mastery; Barrot V3 remains the execution and verification foundation.

findings.detail: Fresh-main PR #1343 ports the legacy accuracy correction onto main SHA 439f533d0fd726262ec80aea9e4ea602d0e23e50. Exact-head core CI passed 299 tests plus 8 subtests in 7.01 seconds; fail-closed gate passed. PR is draft, unmerged and reported mergeable=true.

Main still publishes 1659 checked / 772 correct / 46.5%. The evaluator uses later live price at variable elapsed horizons and mutates historical rows. This cannot be interpreted as fixed-horizon out-of-sample predictive skill. PR #1343 marks it NOT_EVALUATED / NOT_COMPARABLE, preserves the legacy metric for audit, prevents history mutation, and makes the workflow read-only/artifact-only.

Main branch reports protected=true but empty required status-check contexts/checks. Main merge queue remains mutation-capable. Paper trader is manual-dispatch-only but persisted state contains a nonzero position with position_product=null. No state mutation or workflow dispatch occurred.

Three unsynchronized dashboards report about $1.44B, $2.03B and $3.02B XRP open interest. Their cutoffs, venue universes and aggregation methods are not reconciled; no derivatives feature is admitted.

Alpha Finance reports $0 for Oct 28 in a five-fund dollar series; the earlier XRP Insights snapshot labels +174,140 XRP provisional for Oct 28 in a different fund universe. This is a unit/scope/settlement conflict, not an established directional flow signal.

Official Coinbase notice schedules Q3 results for Oct 29 after market close. At this capture, indexed official IR results surfaced the schedule and Q2 baseline but not a confirmed Q3 release. No Q3 results or XRP price effects are inferred.

interpretation: The highest-impact fix is honest evaluation status: the 46.5% legacy accuracy figure is not comparable forecast skill and remains on main until PR #1343 is approved. PR #1343 passes exact-head CI/gate but remains draft/unmerged. Current derivatives and ETF-flow observations conflict across scopes and timestamps and are excluded from model features. Coinbase Q2 results show material USDC and business-diversification exposure, but these company-wide metrics do not establish XRP-specific flow or causal price effects.
unknowns: PR #1343 remains draft and unmerged; passing checks and mergeable=true do not authorize a merge.
No fixed-horizon immutable XRP forecast/outcome ledger, walk-forward benchmark, or calibrated return-probability model is implemented; forecast status remains NOT_ISSUED.
Coinbase Q3 results publication status is unresolved at this capture; Q2 data must not be substituted for Q3.
Open-interest dashboard venue overlap, instrument coverage, timestamp alignment and funding interval normalization remain unknown.
XRP ETF fund populations, holdings timestamps and settlement rules remain unreconciled across trackers.
Effective branch-protection rulesets and bypass behavior are not verified despite the branch metadata showing protected=true.
